acceptance: The Velox service starts in the release UAT shard and its cells run.
A start failure records the container log in the shard artifact.
context:
Evidence: release-v2 run 40971306663 (tag v0.5.0rc2, commit b1459438d), artifact release-uat-v0.5.0rc2-stage3-query-engines: cells.jsonl, uat_gate_summary.json, validator_rollup.tsv, uat_lifecycle.log and per-cell logs. The artifacts do not keep result JSON, so query-level causes need a local rerun of the named cells. See uat_lifecycle.log lines 58-75.

Hosted trunk UAT run https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox/actions/runs/42536258036 completed with failure at source 2d796acd59be06ab4b4a1742dda84cff419202b9. Velox: all 17 selected cells passed on the real hosted runner; the current selected shard did not fail at container startup. Counts cover the selected current matrix only; no historical issue is closed by this note. The full run is still red (702/710 passed), so this is not release certification.

Closed 2026-11-11 against current evidence: PR #3774 let the Velox container load Gluten's native libraries. Trunk UAT 42718296767 (52615914): Velox compose up, ps and declared-settings ok, 17/17 cells passed; scheduled 42789483182 (ce39d768) query-engines green. Startup or readiness failures write container-logs-<platform>.log (execute.py:365-486; test_phases.py:1054, :1338). Image-source decision (GHCR mirror vs runner build) was not an acceptance line.
description: In the stage 3 query-engines shard the image benchbox-velox:dev could not be pulled ('repository does not exist'), was built on the runner, and the velox-connect container exited (1) during compose --wait, so no Velox cell ran. Capture the container log, fix the start failure, and decide whether the image should come from the GHCR mirror instead of a runner build.
